comments.author: MuffDivers2_
comments.body: The way I see it, we are early to the new normal. People haven't fully accepted it yet but they will in time. it is not going away. It is better to get on now. Or you can grind for 3 years to do right by todays crowed,  By the time you release people will have accepted AI as the new norm and you will just be starting out then. I rather have a 3 year head start. Make great things with AI now and people can come back and appreciate them when the world catches up.
